title: Good Drop Configuration
statement: For a Boolean mode, Boolean history $h$, and configuration $a$ of the nine-register machine, call the configuration good when it is a predecessor configuration for that machine after history $h$, and every register value is at most $4|h|+4$.
caveat: The predecessor-configuration predicate and machine semantics are not defined in the supplied statement.
